manual_baseline: same Goal Parser; human-written exact SymPy operators; independent certificate
automatic_arm: same Goal Parser; admitted arithmetic programs induced only from 603 training traces; no manual operator substitution
fallback: Bot-NoBank unchanged prompt, no partial-result injection

paid_gate.fresh_policy: original grouped dev only; exclude prior used tasks, all prior root/remainder coverage-screen tasks, all this-round engineering tasks; reject digit/variable clones and near duplicates; fixed code before inspecting reserved pool

gate_rationale: At least12 eligible tasks over3 structures and3 genuine automatic-bank cases permits a minimal comparison without filling with ineligible controls. This is a feasibility gate, not a power calculation or noninferiority claim.
engineering_split_policy: All previously inspected or used development tasks are development evidence, never newly independent tests.
